title: Mail asks before sending an empty message or a missing attachment
steps: On a test account, press c, add your own test address and press ⌘↵ with no subject and no text
Press Return, then type "The notes are attached" and a subject and press ⌘↵
Click Send Anyway, then press ⌘Z in the undo window
Write a subject and a line with no mention of files and press ⌘↵
expected: The first send shows a native alert "Send without a subject or text?" with Keep Writing as the default button; Return goes back to the draft. The second asks "Send without an attachment?". Send Anyway sends with the usual undo window and ⌘Z brings the draft back. The last message sends with no prompt. Send later asks the same with Schedule Anyway.
